Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: high quality FULL-BODY character splash illustration atlas for fantasy bullet-hell game STARBORNE. Three equal columns on a wide 3:2 image, one complete character per column, head-to-toe including all hair, hands, coat tails and both boots. Each subject takes almost the entire height with 7 percent clear padding at top/bottom and plenty of separation. Not a bust, not a waist-up image, no cropping.
Art direction: the beautiful polished anime fantasy character illustration aesthetic of Genshin Impact official character wish art: precise elegant linework, clean luminous cel shading, subtle colored gradients, exquisite readable costume details, appealing expressive face, graceful adult proportions, distinct materials, silk and engraved metal. An original character identity and costume. Cleaner and more beautiful than the reference, avoid muddy painterly noise and generic western fantasy realism.
Reference image ONLY establishes existing character identities, hair colors and costume palette, not layout or rendering quality.
All three columns depict the exact SAME adult character and outfit, with a dramatic graceful spell-casting pose and floating fabric. Left: healthy, immaculate complete costume, confident expression, bright elemental relic. Middle: wounded, clearly visible small cheek scratch, dusty sleeves, frayed and torn outer cape hem and a scuffed bracer, determined expression. Right: critical but still standing/casting, visibly battered, disheveled hair, several small scratches, pronounced torn outer coat tails and scarf, cracked outer armor, leaning with effort, still resolute. Damage is non-graphic battle wear. Maintain full opaque coverage of torso, chest, hips and upper legs at every health level; wear and tears affect outer garments, not underwear or skin exposure. No sexualization, no gore, no exposed private areas. Strongly visible health progression while retaining beauty and exact identity.
Perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma key background for background removal, no shadows or background texture. No text, labels, frames, lines or watermark. No neighboring figures touching. Head and feet entirely visible. Three full-body illustrations, precisely one per column.
Character: adult woman in her twenties, copper-red loose wavy shoulder-length hair, amber eyes. Ivory and deep-teal tailored fantasy flight dress with burnished copper filigree, a floating compass relic, asymmetric long split coat tails, fitted opaque leggings and elegant boots. Warm gold crystal ribbons and compass-star motif.
